title: Keychain Wristlet
description: A tiny crochet wrist strap that attaches to your keys. Fastest project in the collection.
expectationText: The perfect starter project to use up scrap yarn. In under 15 minutes you get a practical wristlet that makes carrying keys easier.

steps.title: Start the wrist loop
steps.instruction: Chain 6. This will be the width of the wristlet. Join with a slip stitch to form a ring, making sure the chain is not twisted.

steps.title: Rounds 1 to 3
steps.instruction: Single crochet around the ring, working into each chain. Join with a slip stitch at the end of each round.

steps.title: Extend the strap
steps.instruction: Stop joining rounds and work a long foundation chain of about 40 chains for the wrist strap. This will be the loop that goes around your wrist.

steps.title: Reinforce the strap
steps.instruction: Single crochet back along the chain to make the strap sturdy. Fasten off.

steps.title: Attach the keyring
steps.instruction: Thread the starting ring through the keyring or clasp, then pull the strap end through the ring to create a lark's head knot. Pull tight.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in any ends and clip on your keys. Done.
